_comment: Every download is pinned to a repository commit and verified with SHA-256 before use. All models are MIT-licensed and downloaded by the user; none are bundled in the APK.

models.name: Whisper tiny (q5_1)
models.description: Fastest, lowest accuracy. For older or 32-bit phones.
models.license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper; ggml conversion by the whisper.cpp authors)

models.name: Whisper base (q5_1)
models.description: Balanced speed and accuracy. Default for Fast and Balanced modes.
models.license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper; ggml conversion by the whisper.cpp authors)

models.name: Whisper small (q5_1)
models.description: Best accuracy on phones. Recommended for High Accuracy and Full Movie modes.
models.license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper; ggml conversion by the whisper.cpp authors)

models.name: Silero VAD v6.2.0
models.description: Voice activity detection: skips silence and music so Whisper does not invent lines there. Required.
models.license: MIT (Silero Team; ggml conversion by the whisper.cpp authors)

models.name: M2M100 418M translator (int8)
models.description: Translates what Whisper hears into English. Much better than Whisper's own translation with tiny and base; with small, Whisper's own translation scored a little higher in our tests. 64-bit phones with 4 GB RAM or more.
models.license: MIT (Meta AI M2M100; CTranslate2 int8 conversion by Jon Craton)
